Maya Chen: Quick heads up — Ananya Rao (final onsite candidate) is arriving Tue 2026-05-12. Flight lands ~07:40 local. Her final loop is 10:00–12:30 PT in our SF office. We need: visitor badge, laptop loaner for whiteboarding, short onsite greeter, and a quiet room for a 30m technical pairing. Also one interviewer (Ben) will join remotely from EMEA — need bridge + mic checks. Can ops/facilities/security triage?

Alex Kim: Thanks Maya. I can cover the pairing room logistics but need the laptop and badge. Can someone confirm where she should check in?

Priya Sharma: I’ll own visitor onboarding and welcome packet. Riley — can you reserve a hot desk + monitor and confirm access to a standing desk (candidate requested)? Also I’ll send the NDA link and dietary prefs to the candidate.

Riley Brooks: Reserving hot desk near room C3, monitor + HDMI. Standing desk available. Note: badge printer on 6th floor is down; we’ll do manual badge and pre-print the pass at reception. Greeter assigned at 09:15 to meet at Lobby A. Door code for greeter entrance (for contractors) is `4821` — keep internal. Parking permit PDF uploaded to our shared folder: https://files.redwood.com/visitor-permits/perm-523.pdf

Luis Gomez: Please add Ananya to the Visitor DB with name + passport name + ETA so security can pre-clear. Don’t post passport number in channel — DM me when you have it. Also confirm laptop imaging policy — loaner must be wiped after use, signed form required.

Ben Turner: I’ll be remote 11:00–12:00 PT. Can we get a test call at 10:30 PT and a stable video bridge link? My timezone is BST that day.

recruiting-bot: Calendar invite created by Maya: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1769998888. Attached: welcome-packet.pdf, interview-schedule.pdf. Candidate contact: ananya.rao@email.com.

Maya Chen: Thanks — I’ll DM Luis the passport name and ETA and confirm dietary note (vegetarian). Ben — I’ll add you to the test call at 10:30 PT. Riley — could you drop a short note on parking pickup location for the greeter?

Riley Brooks: Parking pickup will be at the visitor lane on 2nd St (north side), greeter will meet at gate and escort to Lobby A. I’ll leave a printed route map at reception.

Priya Sharma: All set on my end — NDA sent, welcome packet has accessibility info and standing desk confirmation. I’ll be onsite for check-in at 09:00.

Alex Kim: Perfect — appreciate the quick turn. One last ask: if badge printer still down, can we have a backup lanyard pack?

Riley Brooks: Yes, backup lanyards are with reception. I’ll confirm badge printing fallback at 08:45 and post an update here.

Maya Chen: Great — will follow up after I DM Luis. Thanks everyone :tada:
